methods.title: Legacy Bayesian importance-sampling engine
methods.source_location: ARR Book 3 Chapter 2 section 2.6.3.6 equations 3.2.52 to 3.2.54; Kuczera (1999) p. 1554 equations (16)-(17) explicit SD scaling; legacy report summaries; exact native proposal and solver controls remain unqualified
methods.purpose: Replicate the legacy production importance-sampling calculation and verified controls for the specified likelihood and prior
key_assumptions: Exact target density in legacy coordinates
Explicit positive finite proposal SD multiplier gamma; full covariance gamma squared times inverse curvature, not a change to the target or a native default
Adequate proposal coverage and target-specific numerical precision
Random controls and repeatability recorded where available
Independent MCMC or quadrature may verify the result but do not silently replace the production algorithm
validation_required: Matched legacy run controls and output comparisons
Deterministic conjugate Normal weighted-coordinate moments and empirical interval refinement
Independent correlated modal curvature, affine coordinate changes, rejection and actual builder-to-sampler weighted outputs
Explicit gamma scaling: correlated covariance and Normal log-density identities, gamma=1 equivalence, representability and scaled builder-to-sampler posterior checks
Exact CSV lognormal execution against analytic predictive probability; estimated-scale censored execution against independent quadrature, seeded replay, and independent censor, unit and prior checks

Bounded known-scale exact-record precision audit against conjugate Normal reference outputs, centered residual MCSE, simultaneous inverse and transformed intervals, reproducibility and retained unsuccessful attempts
Censored and estimated-scale scalar regressions, strict Gaussian moment conditions, and bounded normalized-ratio admission for exactly reflected records with independently known scalar references
Fixed-scale/fixed-shape GEV and LP3 location-only binding with independent density/censor and posterior quadrature regression cases
evidence_gaps: Independent local curvature, explicit full covariance scaling, Normal importance draws, explicit lognormal binding and a bounded known-scale exact-record precision audit are composed in the issue #6 CLI implementation; installed acceptance, broader model/exposure precision admission and native comparison remain outstanding.

The internal API also supports explicitly configured fixed-scale censored parameter mean and expected CDF/direct AEP using complete deterministic enclosures. An additional route admits exactly reflected fixed- or estimated-scale lognormal records for independently known scalars. General censored transformed/inverse outputs, broad estimated-scale precision remain outstanding.
GEV and LP3 posterior bindings cover location-only inference with explicit fixed log-scale and shape. See wp06-fixed-family-posterior.md for evidence and remaining limitations.
Actual native Flike optimizer/proposal, random controls, stopping and output interpolation are not established; external native qualification remains separate.
ESS, approximate mean Monte Carlo standard error, and independent seeds do not by themselves validate extreme-tail flood estimates or native equivalence.
